title: Official Register 1919-1920 (Redbook), Vote for Secretary of State of Iowa, 1846-1918
note: Years run down the page, one candidate list per year with a printed Total Vote per year; the day for each year is in `days` (year-01-01 before 1906 to match the archive's year-precision elections). Page 572 holds governor 1912-1918 above the secretary of state table that starts at 1846. Election days before 1906 follow Iowa's statutes (Oct 26 1846 sourced; first Monday in August 1848-1854; second Tuesday in October 1856-1880; November from 1882), not read from the page.
